column2: Indicate your application for priority in the online application form Submit a disability assessment to Vanguard Healthcare at AL.Admin@vanguardhealthcare.com.sg before the flat application period closes You are strongly encouraged to obtain a disability assessment prior to the sales exercise, so that there is no delay in your application. Your application for priority will not be considered if Vanguard Healthcare does not receive your disability assessment before the flat application period closes.

column1: How to obtain a disability assessment
column2: You may obtain the disability assessment by visiting a General Practitioner or arrange with your care provider to complete a Functional Assessment Report (FAR) . The cost of an assessment may vary. Please contact your preferred doctor for more information. You do not need to obtain the disability assessment if: You have submitted your disability status to the Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) prior to 31 August 2024 and there is no change to your disability status. You are a current recipient of any of the following AIC schemes as of 31 August 2024: Home Caregiving Grant (HCG) Pioneer Generation Disability Assistance Scheme (PDGAS) ElderShield Interim Disability Assistance Programme for the Elderly (IDAPE) administered by AIC ElderFund Medisave-Care CareShield Life (CSHL)
